title: Hazard flags
limitations: Interpretive flags: HARD_HAZARD is team-digitised; LOW_TI is not set (no defensible TI threshold for this AOI, U-03 decided 2026-11-10), so no cell is marked as possible loose fines; TI_UNKNOWN marks missing TI coverage; LOW_RES_DEM identifies cells filled by lower-resolution DEM sources when source mapping is available. Tiles are drawn at the 5 m routing-grid cell size; a cell with several flags shows the colour of the highest-priority one (hard hazard, low thermal inertia, low-resolution DEM, thermal inertia unknown, no data); class values are the flag bit values.
